aggregate_note: Arm-1 showed a promising ~7.1%% aggregate macro-WER improvement (base 0.3352 -> best s14000 0.3114); that does not override the preservation-sentinel failure.

basis.either_way: Under the design's any-loss rule the point-estimate loss already disqualifies Arm-1; the NI test independently fails to clear it. Both point to rejection.

lingala_point_estimate.reading: the point estimate is a LOSS (+0.70 pts), which the design's any-loss rule disqualifies outright.

noninferiority_test.reading: non-inferiority to base within a 1-point margin was NOT ESTABLISHED (upper 95%% CI 0.0127 > 0.01). This is a FAILURE TO ESTABLISH non-inferiority, NOT a proof of regression beyond the margin.

basis.preservation_requirement: B5-UNIVERSAL-PILOT-DESIGN-2026-001: swahili/lingala are strong regression sentinels — ANY loss is disqualifying.

data_caveat: The 386-row lingala sentinel is an EXPANDED re-measurement drawn from the SAME development pools (fleurs + soreva tier2-dev) and CONTAINS the 60 rows used during checkpoint selection — it is a larger-sample dev-only preservation check, NOT independent held-out data. It is sufficient to REJECT (a dev regression is disqualifying) but must NOT be read as an independent confirmation.
decisions: Route to the planned preservation/distillation Arm-2.
Do NOT weaken Arm-1's any-loss preservation rule.
Do NOT consume any sealed set.
statement: Arm-1 FAILED the predeclared preservation requirement and non-inferiority was NOT established; route to the planned preservation/distillation Arm-2. No sealed data consumed.
